visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four people stand outside a brightly lit store at night with a red logo "Shimamura" and white text below. A man in glasses and blue sweater gestures excitedly toward the camera while a woman in a cap and two children stand behind him. The camera is handheld and moves slightly to capture the building exterior. (2) Interior shots of the store show expansive aisles filled with racks of colorful clothing, mannequin displays in the windows, and shelves lined with bags. Store employees in red patterned vests are seen walking through the store, and bright white overhead lighting illuminates the clean, modern retail environment. (3) The individuals are shown in various parts of the store browsing for items. The man holds up a black coat in front of a mirror, checking the fit while pointing at the price tag. The woman examines soft blankets and heat-tech underwear packages on a shelf, showing the texture to the camera. The girl looks at a display of handbags and water bottles. (4) A young boy in a Santa hat carries a large white balloon while walking past shelves of towels and plush toys. Close-up shots show the man holding a green dinosaur-shaped sleeping bag and the woman holding a black and white shark-themed one, smiling and laughing at the camera. (5) The family sits together on a white floor surrounded by shopping bags and gifts. They wave and cheer at the camera in a group shot. The final shot shows the father and son lying on the floor inside their animal-themed sleeping bags, moving playfully like fish out of water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, festive electronic background music. A male voice speaks rapidly with high pitch variability and an enthusiastic, friendly tone. Occasional 'whoosh' sound effects mark fast visual transitions. (2) Inside the store, the BGM continues as a steady, upbeat track. A female voice joins the mix, speaking in a professional yet warm narrative style. There is faint background chatter and the audible sound of rustling plastic packaging as items are handled. (3) A percussive 'ding' sound effect occurs repeatedly when a price or specific product feature is mentioned. The male speaker's voice remains dominant, exhibiting moderate conversational loudness as he describes items like coats and heat-tech shirts. (4) The young girl's voice is heard briefly, speaking in a casual, somewhat shy tone. The BGM maintains its volume, providing a energetic bed for the dialogue. Occasional low-frequency thuds from footsteps on the store floor are present. (5) The finale features multiple voices (the family) cheering "Merry Christmas" in unison over a crescendo in the BGM. A cartoonish 'boing' or comical SFX accompanies the final playful scene on the floor, where vocal arousal and joy reach their peak.
